meaning.en: Intended to curb or eradicate criminal activity.
meaning.vi: Dự định để kiềm chế hoặc xóa bỏ hoạt động tội phạm.

meaning.en: Opposed to or aimed at preventing or punishing crime.
meaning.vi: Chống đối hoặc nhằm ngăn chặn hoặc trừng phạt tội phạm.

sentences.en: Democrats have gutted the anti-crime bill.

sentences.en: Anti-crime efforts including federal aid for hiring 100, 000 new local police officers.

sentences.en: He has touted his anti-crime credentials by ordering guidelines for local authorities that would oust from public housing residents who commit crimes.
